library_preparation_preflight.summary: Pure in-process MockMvc/@WebMvcTest slice-test support; all dependencies are plain non-optional Spring Boot modules (spring-boot-webmvc, spring-boot-test-autoconfigure -> spring-test) resolved transitively. No DB/broker/Docker involved, matching the two already-onboarded sibling '-test' modules (spring-boot-restclient-test, spring-boot-micrometer-metrics-test) which needed no special setup.
library_preparation_preflight.agent_guidance: Exercise the autoconfigure classes in org.springframework.boot.webmvc.test.autoconfigure (e.g. via ApplicationContextRunner or a minimal @WebMvcTest controller + MockMvc), following the pattern used in spring-boot-restclient-test and spring-boot-micrometer-metrics-test tests.
risks: @WebMvcTest's optional HtmlUnit WebClient and Selenium WebDriver integration support is conditional on those libraries being on the classpath; they are not declared dependencies of this artifact, so that narrow code path won't be covered without adding htmlunit/selenium testImplementation deps separately — not required for meaningful core coverage.
